resources.string: Tracks the foreground app and automates the system Force stop screen when you tap the ApKilla Quick Settings tile.
One tap in Quick Settings force-stops the app that was in the foreground before you opened the notification shade. No root, ADB, Shizuku or Tasker.
The Android App info screen may flash briefly while ApKilla presses Force stop and confirms it automatically. The Accessibility permission normally survives a reboot.
Couldn’t find the Force stop controls on this Android skin.
Open Quick Settings edit mode and add the “Kill app” tile manually.
